## Summary
- **Scenario redesign**: Students now assess diabetes management complexity (Routine/Moderate/High) instead of classifying type — requires multi-query reasoning across HbA1c, eGFR, UACR, medications, and conditions
- **UI improvements**: Split investigate/classify into separate cells, added clinical reference card, stratified candidate pool for diverse cases
- **Pedagogy fixes**: Removed baked-in AI decision rules, replaced prescriptive checklist with abstract progress indicator, weakened default prompt to force iteration
- **Colab verified**: All cells execute cleanly against live FHIR server (134s, no errors)

## Agent pipeline used
1. Clinical Scenario Designer — redesigned scenario with data-informed mapping
2. Synthetic Data Architect — discovered existing FHIR data is richer than assumed (UACR exists, 148 non-DM controls, eGFR 29-99)
3. Education Reviewer — found 4 pedagogy issues, all fixed
4. Implementation Reviewer — found 3 technical issues, all fixed

## Test plan
- [x] Local validation (nb_validate.py) — passes
- [x] Local smoke test (test_demo_notebook.py) — 8/8 PASS
- [x] Colab execution — all cells run cleanly (134s)
- [x] 15-position screenshot verification — all 15 checklist items confirmed
- [ ] Joel's manual review of student experience in Colab

…essment

The scenario now asks students to assess diabetes management complexity
(Routine/Moderate/High) instead of classifying diabetes type — requiring
multi-query reasoning across HbA1c, eGFR, UACR, medications, and conditions
rather than a single C-peptide lookup.

Key changes:
- Split investigate/classify into separate dropdown cells
- Added clinical reference card with complexity factors and thresholds
- Stratified candidate pool for phenotype diversity across runs
- Removed baked-in AI decision rules (student's prompt now matters)
- Replaced prescriptive evidence checklist with abstract progress indicator
- Weakened default Activity 2 prompt to force iteration
- Added UACR to the FHIR query toolkit
- Colab-verified: all cells execute cleanly against live FHIR server

Agent pipeline sessions (scenario designer, synthetic data architect,
education reviewer, implementation reviewer) captured in agent-history/.

commits.messageBody:
When Colab's runtime restarts (idle timeout, manual restart, or fresh open),
cells that reference _state crash with NameError instead of showing a helpful
message. This is the actual student experience — they run cells individually,
not via Run All.

Added guards to Steps 5, 5b, 6, 7, 8, and 9 that detect missing _state and
display "Runtime was reset — use Runtime → Run all" instead of a traceback.

Also re-uploaded a fresh notebook (clean outputs) to prevent cached outputs
from a previous Run All from misleading students into thinking cells have
already executed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: Add runtime-reset guards to all interactive cells

title: Redesign diabetes notebook: type classification → complexity assessment
